drr_estimates.formula: Use each dataset own measured b04/b05 mean_block60 and non_block_overhead_seconds for the corresponding heavy window. For b01-b03, t_block60 = dataset_measured_b05_mean_block60 * (M*N*min(M,N))/(dataset_b05_M*dataset_b05_N*min(dataset_b05_M,dataset_b05_N)); the within-dataset FFT bin count is unchanged. CPU = overhead + adopted_blocks*t_block60; wall = overhead + ceil(adopted_blocks/12)*t_block60. Same rank-30 cost for all ranks. S1 list scheduling follows candidate_priority; omit imported a02_b02. Three seeds use the slowest candidate and at most two concurrent seed jobs.
drr_estimates.limitations: All four measurements use overlap [0,4,0,4], rather than adopted b04 [0,6,0,6] / b05 [0,8,0,8]. b04 measured/adopted block counts: FORGE 16/25, C3 32/50; b05: FORGE 9/9, C3 18/18. Heavy-window per-block timings are proxies for the adopted schedule; 60-iteration scaling includes FFT/setup. Other-window Hankel scaling, ideal worker throughput, concurrent-candidate contention and input/RSS replication remain unvalidated.
